name: cafeteria-system
description: Campus Cafeteria - full-stack ordering system (React + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
